co-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
co-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Colorado's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
co-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

co-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
co-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Colorado's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
co-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's or town's mayor or council members, or a city's or town's own published list of them.

co-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
co-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Colorado's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
co-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

co-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
co-tribal-government.why: This app has not read either Colorado tribe's council list yet. Each tribe publishes its own, which has to be read one tribe at a time.
co-tribal-government.wanted: Each tribe's own published list of its council, read one tribe at a time.
